subject: SLA & Premium Support: package options and pilot proposal
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@hometownbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: SLA & Premium Support: package options and pilot proposal

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a concise set of options so your procurement & ops teams can evaluate trade-offs quickly. Key points up front:

- We can offer three uptime bands: 99.9%, 99.95%, 99.99% (monthly uptime SLA).
- Standard support (included): business-hours triage, 24h major-incident ack.
- Premium support (add-on): 1h first response, 24/7 escalation coverage, named escalation path, and a 30-min paging SLT for sev1 at 99.99 band.
- Retainer model: optional 24/7 on-call retainer (monthly) that reduces incident resolution labor charges and grants faster routing to senior engineers.
- Credits: we propose a scaled credit table tied to outage minutes rather than percent bands for clearer billing (see "redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx").

Pilot suggestion: 60-day pilot on 99.95 SLA with the premium support add-on at a 20% pilot discount, subject to a capped support retainer of $6k/month for the pilot period. If you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity within 30 days of pilot completion, we will convert pilot discounts into a 12% committed spend discount and hold the pilot premium retainer at the pilot rate for 3 months.

Can you confirm the right procurement contact and whether the pilot retainer level is within budget? I'll loop in Laura from Legal for an expedited SOW draft once you confirm.

Thanks,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments referenced: redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (pricing + credit table).

From: Anika Shah <anika@hometownbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support: package options and pilot proposal

Diego —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few clarification items from my side after a quick read and an ops sync: 

1) On credits: can you convert the outage-minute table into an example invoice line for a typical monthly spend of $45k so we can see the delta?
2) For the 99.99 band, does the 30-min paging apply to both production and DR failover events? Our risk team will expect symmetrical treatment.
3) On the pilot discount: procurement prefers discounts to be reflected as one consolidated pilot credit line rather than a per-month discount — can you accommodate that?

Also, procurement will want to see the SLO language called out in the SOW (notification windows, measurement windows, and remediation playbook). Please loop in whoever owns legal/terms.

I'll introduce procurement on my side in a follow-up if this aligns; our procurement lead is procurement@hometownbank.com.

Best,
Anika Shah
Head of Cloud Ops, Hometown Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hometown Bank clarification — discount & credit framing (internal)

Diego / Priyom —

Internal notes for negotiation posture:

- Credits: procurement asks for invoice-level example. Priyom, can you produce a single-page example invoice showing a $45k monthly spend and the credit applied as a lump-sum pilot credit (not per-month)? Use the existing minute-based credit table but roll into one line.
- Paging symmetry: we're OK to include DR failover events in the 30-min paging for the 99.99 band but add a clear definition for what counts as 'DR failover' (automatic infra-triggered failover only; manual DR drills excluded).
- Pilot retainer: accept procurement's request to show it as a single pilot credit line. We'll keep the numeric pilot economics unchanged (equivalent to 20% over two months).
- Escalation coverage: recommend we offer a named 24/7 escalation engineer for the pilot; map to a single seat in the retainer to keep costs predictable.

Laura, please prepare a short SOW template (2 pages) that calls out measurement windows, invoice-level crediting option, and the DR definition above. Priyom, pricing example needed by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@hometownbank.com>, procurement@hometownbank.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support: package options and pilot proposal

Anika / Procurement —

Thanks — we've converted the credit table into an example invoice and attached it (redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, sheet: "InvoiceExamples"). Key changes per your ask:

- Pilot credit will be presented as a single pilot credit line on the invoice; the attached example shows the original minute-based calculation in a hidden sheet for audit.
- 99.99 paging: DR failover events are included per the definition below (automated failover initiated by our routing/infra layer). Manual failovers and scheduled DR drills are excluded and will be logged but not credit-triggering.
- SOW next steps: Laura will share a 2-page SOW with SLO callouts and the invoice-level credit option.

If procurement confirms the pilot retainer cap of $6k/month (presented as one pilot credit line of $10.8k covering the two-month pilot), we'll prepare the SOW and a clean signature path via DocuSign.

Diego

From: Anika Shah <anika@hometownbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hometownbank.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support: package options and pilot proposal

Diego / team —

This looks reasonable. Procurement has reviewed the invoice example and confirms the single-line pilot credit format will work. A couple quick asks before we sign the pilot SOW: 

1) Can you add a clause that limits cumulative monthly credits to the monthly invoice amount (we do not want negative invoices)?
2) For the 99.99 band, please include the exact pager escalation list (title/role) that will receive the 30-min page.

If you include those in the SOW, procurement is ready to execute the pilot SOW and we can aim to start the pilot week of 6/28. Please send DocuSign link once SOW is ready.

Thanks,
Anika
